unsavedDialog.leaveDescription: Your current edits won't be saved if you leave. You can keep editing and save first.
unsavedDialog.closeDescription: Your current edits won't be saved if you close this dialog.

outboundPreview.missingBoth: Primary delivery channel is missing From name and sender address.
outboundPreview.missingAddress: Primary delivery channel is missing sender address.
outboundPreview.missingAlias: Primary delivery channel is missing From name.
outboundPreview.unsubscribeTitle: Preview placeholder — replaced with a real unsubscribe link on send

authentication.message: Access key or API authentication failed
authentication.hint: Verify that your AccessKey / Secret or SendGrid API Key is accurate and not expired.

configuration.hint: Verify that the sender address, domain verification, and region/data center match your provider console.

rate_limit.message: Sending quota or rate limit reached
rate_limit.hint: Try again later, or raise your quota / lower the send rate in your provider console.

temporary.hint: Usually a transient outage — retry shortly or check your provider's status page.

permanent.hint: Check the recipient address, content, and sender domain reputation, or inspect bounce logs in your provider console.

unknown.hint: Expand technical details below or check delivery logs in your provider console.

providerUnsupported.message: This delivery channel type is not supported for sending
providerUnsupported.hint: Switch to a supported channel in Settings or contact your administrator.

channelConfigChanged.message: Channel configuration changed during the test
channelConfigChanged.hint: Make sure the current form is saved, then send a new test email.

taskNotMatched.hint: The receipt may be delayed or archived. Refresh delivery details and try again.

senderNotVerified.message: Sender address or domain is not verified
senderNotVerified.hint: Complete domain or sender verification in your provider console and try again.

regionMismatch.hint: Confirm that your DirectMail region, Amazon SES region, or SendGrid data center matches your console.

credentialDecrypt.hint: Contact your administrator to check the CREDENTIAL_KEYRING encryption key.

network.message: Network error connecting to email provider
network.hint: Try again shortly. If this persists, check outbound network or firewall settings.

serviceUnavailable.hint: Try again shortly or check your provider's status page.

unrecognized.message: Delivery failed with an unrecognized provider error
unrecognized.hint: Expand technical details for the raw error code or check receipts in your provider console.

language.label: Language
language.saveFailed: Failed to switch language. Please try again.
